variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 9x39mm SP
variants.info:
A conversion for the RSH-12.
Trades off the stopping power of 12.7x55mm for the slightly better ballistics of 9x39mm SP, along with less recoil!
Changes the gun's name to the RSH-9!

variants.name: 28 Gauge
variants.info: Loads your revolver in 28 Gauge shells effectively turning it into a full on shotgun revolver!
